name: Isaiah Brown
tagline: Animator, digital artist, and maker of small, careful things.

bio: I'm Isaiah, an 18-year-old animator and digital artist from Conyers, Georgia.

I make short animations and illustrations in Photoshop, Animate, and After Effects. When I'm not at the screen, I'm in the shop building and laser-engraving wood pieces. I love the small details, whether that's a two-frame blink or a 0.5 mm engraved line.
I also love to cook, which is basically animation with better snacks.

commissionNote: Like this piece? I take commissions for custom versions. Send me a message with what you have in mind.
